title: Job Interview Basics
subtitle: First-round interview conversation — for English learners

sentences.en: Thank you for coming in today. Please, have a seat and make yourself comfortable.
sentences.target: Thank you for coming in today. Please, have a seat and make yourself comfortable.

sentences.en: Thank you for the opportunity — I'm excited to learn more about the role.
sentences.target: Thank you for the opportunity — I'm excited to learn more about the role.

sentences.en: Could you start by telling me a little bit about your background?
sentences.target: Could you start by telling me a little bit about your background?

sentences.en: Of course. I have three years of experience in customer service and a degree in business administration.
sentences.target: Of course. I have three years of experience in customer service and a degree in business administration.

sentences.en: What attracted you to apply for a position at our company?
sentences.target: What attracted you to apply for a position at our company?

sentences.en: I really respect your focus on training and on promoting from within the team.
sentences.target: I really respect your focus on training and on promoting from within the team.

sentences.en: Tell me about a difficult problem you solved at a previous job.
sentences.target: Tell me about a difficult problem you solved at a previous job.

sentences.en: Once, our system went down right before a busy weekend, and I helped coordinate manual orders.
sentences.target: Once, our system went down right before a busy weekend, and I helped coordinate manual orders.

sentences.en: What are your salary expectations for this position?
sentences.target: What are your salary expectations for this position?

sentences.en: Based on the market and my experience, I'm looking for something in the mid-fifties range.
sentences.target: Based on the market and my experience, I'm looking for something in the mid-fifties range.

sentences.en: Do you have any questions for me about the role or the team?
sentences.target: Do you have any questions for me about the role or the team?

sentences.en: Yes — what does a typical first ninety days look like for someone in this position?
sentences.target: Yes — what does a typical first ninety days look like for someone in this position?
